ComplexType.name: Asset
ComplexType.Comment: Tangible resource of the utility, including power system equipment, various end devices, cabinets, buildings, etc. For electrical network equipment, the role of the asset is defined through PowerSystemResource and its subclasses, defined mainly in the Wires model (refer to IEC61970-301 and model package IEC61970::Wires). Asset description places emphasis on the physical characteristics of the equipment fulfilling that role.

ComplexType.name: AssetContainer
ComplexType.Comment: Asset that is aggregation of other assets such as conductors, transformers, switchgear, land, fences, buildings, equipment, vehicles, etc.

CompoundType.name: ControlledAppliance
CompoundType.Comment: Appliance controlled with a PAN device control.

Simple.name: isElectricVehicle
Simple.Comment: True if the appliance is an electric vehicle.

CompoundType.name: DateTimeInterval
CompoundType.Comment: Interval between two date and time points, where the interval includes the start time but excludes end time.

Simple.name: end
Simple.Comment: End date and time of this interval. The end date and time where the interval is defined up to, but excluded.

Simple.name: start
Simple.Comment: Start date and time of this interval. The start date and time is included in the defined interval.

ComplexType.name: EndDevice
ComplexType.Comment: Asset container that performs one or more end device functions. One type of end device is a meter which can perform metering, load management, connect/disconnect, accounting functions, etc. Some end devices, such as ones monitoring and controlling air conditioners, refrigerators, pool pumps may be connected to a meter. All end devices may have communication capability defined by the associated communication function(s). An end device may be owned by a consumer, a service provider, utility or otherwise.
There may be a related end device function that identifies a sensor or control point within a metering application or communications systems (e.g., water, gas, electricity).
Some devices may use an optical port that conforms to the ANSI C12.18 standard for communications.

Simple.name: installCode
Simple.Comment: Installation code.

Simple.name: isPan
Simple.Comment: If true, this is a premises area network (PAN) device.

Instance.name: Names
Instance.Comment: All names of this identified object.

InverseInstance.name: IdentifiedObject
InverseInstance.Comment: Identified object that this name designates.

Complex.name: UsagePoint
Complex.Comment: Usage point to which this end device belongs.

Simple.name: isSdp
Simple.Comment: If true, this usage point is a service delivery point, i.e., a usage point where the ownership of the service changes hands.

Enumerated.name: phaseCode
Enumerated.Comment: Phase code. Number of wires and specific nominal phases can be deduced from enumeration literal values. For example, ABCN is three-phase, four-wire, s12n (splitSecondary12N) is single-phase, three-wire, and s1n and s2n are single-phase, two-wire.

ComplexType.name: EndDeviceAction
ComplexType.Comment: Action/command performed by an end device on a device other than the end device.

Simple.name: command
Simple.Comment: Command text.

Root.name: EndDeviceControl
Root.Comment: Instructs an end device (or an end device group) to perform a specified action.

Simple.name: drProgramLevel
Simple.Comment: Level of a demand response program request, where 0=emergency. Note: Attribute is not defined on DemandResponseProgram as it is not its inherent property (it serves to control it).

Simple.name: drProgramMandatory
Simple.Comment: Whether a demand response program request is mandatory. Note: Attribute is not defined on DemandResponseProgram as it is not its inherent property (it serves to control it).

Simple.name: issuerID
Simple.Comment: Unique identifier of the business entity originating an end device control.

Simple.name: priceSignal
Simple.Comment: (if applicable) Price signal used as parameter for this end device control.

Compound.name: primaryDeviceTiming
Compound.Comment: Timing for the control actions performed on the device identified in the end device control.

SimpleCompound.name: scheduledInterval
SimpleCompound.Comment: (if control has scheduled duration) Date and time interval the control has been scheduled to execute within.

Choice.name: EndDeviceAction
Choice.Comment: End device action issued by this end device control.

Instance.name: PanDemandResponse
Instance.Comment: PAN control used to issue action/command to PAN devices during a demand response/load control event.

Instance.name: PanDisplay
Instance.Comment: PAN action/command used to issue the displaying of text messages on PAN devices.

Instance.name: PanPricing
Instance.Comment: PAN action/command used to issue pricing information to a PAN device.

Reference.name: EndDeviceControlType
Reference.Comment: Type of this end device control.

InverseReference.name: EndDeviceControls
InverseReference.Comment: All end device controls of this type.

Instance.name: EndDevices
Instance.Comment: All end devices receiving commands from this end device control.

InverseInstance.name: EndDeviceControls
InverseInstance.Comment: All end device controls sending commands to this end device.

Instance.name: UsagePoints
Instance.Comment: All usage points receiving commands from this end device control.

InverseInstance.name: EndDeviceControls
InverseInstance.Comment: All end device controls sending commands to this usage point.

Root.name: EndDeviceControlType
Root.Comment: Detailed description for a control produced by an end device. Values in attributes allow for creation of recommended codes to be used for identifying end device controls as follows: <type>.<domain>.<subDomain>.<eventOrAction>.

Simple.name: type
Simple.Comment: Type of physical device from which the control was created. A value of zero (0) can be used when the source is unknown.

CompoundType.name: EndDeviceTiming
CompoundType.Comment: Timing for the control actions of end devices.

Simple.name: durationIndefinite
Simple.Comment: True if 'duration' is indefinite.

Compound.name: interval
Compound.Comment: Start and end time of an interval during which end device control actions are to be executed.

SimpleEnumerated.name: randomisation
SimpleEnumerated.Comment: Kind of randomisation to be applied to the end device control actions to be executed.

EnumeratedValue.name: default
EnumeratedValue.Comment: Randomisation of start and/or end times involving the operation of one or more devices is controlled by default settings for the device(s).

EnumeratedValue.name: end
EnumeratedValue.Comment: End time of an event or control action affecting one or more devices is randomised to prevent simultaneous operation.

EnumeratedValue.name: none
EnumeratedValue.Comment: Neither the start time nor the end time of an event or control action affecting one or more devices is randomised.

EnumeratedValue.name: start
EnumeratedValue.Comment: Start time of an event or control action affecting one or more multiple devices is randomised.

EnumeratedValue.name: startAndEnd
EnumeratedValue.Comment: Both the start time and the end time of an event or control action affecting one or more devices are randomised to prevent simultaneous operation.

ComplexType.name: IdentifiedObject
ComplexType.Comment: This is a root class to provide common identification for all classes needing identification and naming attributes.

Simple.name: mRID
Simple.Comment: Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

ComplexType.name: Name
ComplexType.Comment: The Name class provides the means to define any number of human readable names for an object. A name is not to be used for defining inter-object relationships. For inter-object relationships instead use the object identification 'mRID'.

Simple.name: name
Simple.Comment: Any free text that name the object.

ComplexType.name: Name2
ComplexType.Comment: The Name class provides the means to define any number of human readable names for an object. A name is not to be used for defining inter-object relationships. For inter-object relationships instead use the object identification 'mRID'.

Simple.name: name
Simple.Comment: Any free text that name the object.

ComplexType.name: PanDemandResponse
ComplexType.Comment: PAN control used to issue action/command to PAN devices during a demand response/load control event.

Simple.name: cancelDateTime
Simple.Comment: Timestamp when a canceling of the event is scheduled to start.

Simple.name: command
Simple.Comment: Command text.

Domain.name: coolingSetpoint
Domain.Comment: Requested cooling set point. Temperature set point is typically defined and calculated based on local temperature.

Simple.name: durationIndefinite
Simple.Comment: True if the action of this control is indefinite.

Domain.name: dutyCycle
Domain.Comment: Maximum "on" state duty cycle as a percentage of time. For example, if the value is 80, the device would be in an "on" state for 80% of the time for the duration of the action.

ComplexType.name: PanDisplay
ComplexType.Comment: PAN action/command used to issue the displaying of text messages on PAN devices.

Simple.name: command
Simple.Comment: Command text.

Simple.name: confirmationRequired
Simple.Comment: If true, the requesting entity (e.g. retail electric provider) requires confirmation of the successful display of the text message.

Simple.name: startDateTime
Simple.Comment: Start date and time for action of this control.

Enumerated.name: transmissionMode
Enumerated.Comment: Transmission mode to be used for this PAN display control.

ComplexType.name: PanPricing
ComplexType.Comment: PAN action/command used to issue pricing information to a PAN device.

Simple.name: command
Simple.Comment: Command text.

Simple.name: startDateTime
Simple.Comment: Start date and time for action of this control.

EnumeratedType.name: PhaseCode
EnumeratedType.Comment: An unordered enumeration of phase identifiers. Allows designation of phases for both transmission and distribution equipment, circuits and loads. The enumeration, by itself, does not describe how the phases are connected together or connected to ground. Ground is not explicitly denoted as a phase.

Residential and small commercial loads are often served from single-phase, or split-phase, secondary circuits. For the example of s12N, phases 1 and 2 refer to hot wires that are 180 degrees out of phase, while N refers to the neutral wire. Through single-phase transformer connections, these secondary circuits may be served from one or two of the primary phases A, B, and C. For three-phase loads, use the A, B, C phase codes instead of s12N.
The integer values are from IEC 61968-9 to support revenue metering applications.

EnumeratedValue.name: ABCN
EnumeratedValue.Comment: Phases A, B, C, and N.

EnumeratedValue.name: XYN
EnumeratedValue.Comment: Two unknown non-neutral phases plus neutral.

EnumeratedType.name: TransmissionModeKind
EnumeratedType.Comment: Transmission mode for end device display controls, applicable to premises area network (PAN) devices.

EnumeratedValue.name: anonymous
EnumeratedValue.Comment: Message transmission mode whereby messages or commands are broadcast to unspecified devices listening for such communications.

EnumeratedValue.name: both
EnumeratedValue.Comment: Message transmission mode whereby messages or commands are sent by both 'normal' and 'anonymous' methods.

EnumeratedValue.name: normal
EnumeratedValue.Comment: Message transmission mode whereby messages or commands are sent to specific devices.

ComplexType.name: UsagePoint
ComplexType.Comment: Logical or physical point in the network to which readings or events may be attributed. Used at the place where a physical or virtual meter may be located; however, it is not required that a meter be present.

Instance.name: Names
Instance.Comment: All names of this identified object.

InverseInstance.name: IdentifiedObject
InverseInstance.Comment: Identified object that this name designates.

SimpleType.name: PerCent
SimpleType.Comment: Percentage on a defined base. For example, specify as 100 to indicate at the defined base.

Simple.name: value
Simple.Comment: Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

SimpleType.name: Temperature
SimpleType.Comment: Value of temperature in degrees Celsius.

PrimitiveType.name: Boolean
PrimitiveType.Comment: A type with the value space "true" and "false".

PrimitiveType.name: DateTime
PrimitiveType.Comment: Date and time as "yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss.sss", which conforms with ISO 8601. UTC time zone is specified as "yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss.sssZ". A local timezone relative UTC is specified as "yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss.sss-hh:mm". The second component (shown here as "ss.sss") could have any number of digits in its fractional part to allow any kind of precision beyond seconds.

PrimitiveType.name: Float
PrimitiveType.Comment: A floating point number. The range is unspecified and not limited.

PrimitiveType.name: Integer
PrimitiveType.Comment: An integer number. The range is unspecified and not limited.

PrimitiveType.name: String
PrimitiveType.Comment: A string consisting of a sequence of characters. The character encoding is UTF-8. The string length is unspecified and unlimited.

Package.name: Assets
Package.Comment: This package contains the core information classes that support asset management applications that deal with the physical and lifecycle aspects of various network resources (as opposed to power system resource models defined in IEC61970::Wires package, which support network applications).

Package.name: Base
Package.Comment: Content of the base CIM published as IEC 61970-301.

Package.name: Core
Package.Comment: Contains the core PowerSystemResource and ConductingEquipment entities shared by all applications plus common collections of those entities. Not all applications require all the Core entities. This package does not depend on any other package except the Domain package, but most of the other packages have associations and generalizations that depend on it.

Package.name: Domain
Package.Comment: The domain package defines primitive datatypes that are used by classes in other packages. Stereotypes are used to describe the datatypes. The following stereotypes are defined:
<<enumeration>> A list of permissible constant values.
<<Primitive>> The most basic data types used to compose all other data types.

<<CIMDatatype>> A datatype that contains a value attribute, an optional unit of measure and a unit multiplier. The unit and multiplier may be specified as a static variable initialized to the allowed value.
<<Compound>> A composite of Primitive, enumeration, CIMDatatype or other Compound classes, as long as the Compound classes do not recurse.
For all datatypes both positive and negative values are allowed unless stated otherwise for a particular datatype.

Package.name: IEC61968
Package.Comment: The IEC 61968 subpackages of the CIM are developed, standardized and maintained by the UCA community including its working groups and task forces.
Currently, normative parts of the model support the needs of information exchange defined in IEC 61968-3, IEC 61968-4, IEC 61968-5, IEC 61968-6, IEC 61968-8, IEC 61968-9 and in IEC 61968-13.

Package.name: Metering
Package.Comment: This package contains the core information classes that support end device applications with specialized classes for metering and premises area network devices, and remote reading functions. These classes are generally associated with the point where a service is delivered to the customer.
